$comment: MCP tool contract for apps/mcp-server (plan section R, ADR-0008). 10 read tools + 2 write tools. Read tools never return raw file bytes. Write tools are disabled unless MCP_WRITE_ENABLED=true AND GATEWAY_WRITE_ENABLED=true, require confirm=true, are rate-limited, size-limited, audited in mcp_audit_log, and append-only. Owned by A02; frozen after P1 (changes require an ADR). Consumers: A10 (implementation), A12 (tests assert the served tool list equals this file), A14 (docs).

tools.name: memory.search
tools.title: Search memory
tools.description: Hybrid (vector + keyword + graph) search over chunks and knowledge artifacts, scoped by project and time, returning cited hits and an assembled context block.

since.description: ISO-8601 instant; only sources observed after this

tools.name: memory.get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project from the registry with its sub-projects and a summary of its current facts.

tools.name: memory.get_entity
tools.title: Get entity
tools.description: One resolved entity with its current facts and full provenance.

tools.name: memory.get_related
tools.title: Get related entities
tools.description: Graph neighbours of an entity with the connecting facts and their validity windows.

tools.name: memory.get_decisions
tools.title: Get decisions
tools.description: Decision artifacts for a project ordered by valid_from; superseded ones are excluded unless asked for.

tools.name: memory.get_timeline
tools.title: Get timeline
tools.description: Ordered events for a project or entity: facts becoming valid or closing, decisions, and source changes.

tools.name: memory.get_sources
tools.title: Get sources
tools.description: Provenance chain for any object id: artifact/fact -> episode -> version -> source -> root/device, plus models and run. Returns logical source URIs, never file bytes.

tools.name: memory.explain
tools.title: Explain
tools.description: Alias of memory.get_sources with a human-readable explanation sentence.

tools.name: memory.get_artifact
tools.title: Get artifact
tools.description: One knowledge artifact with its supersession chain (ADR-0005 rule 6: superseded is a state, not a deletion).

tools.name: memory.get_current_state
tools.title: Get current state
tools.description: Project status, current facts, open tasks, latest decisions, last ingestion run and honest coverage (ADR-0006: the graph lags Tier 1).
tools.output: ProjectState{status, facts[], tasks[], decisions[], last_run, coverage}

tools.name: memory.add_episode
tools.title: Add episode
tools.description: Append a manual episode (origin=mcp) queued for extraction. Disabled by default; requires confirm=true; audited; append-only.

tools.name: memory.record_decision
tools.title: Record decision
tools.description: Append a decision artifact, optionally superseding an existing one (ADR-0005 rule 2: explicit supersession is authoritative). Disabled by default; requires confirm=true; audited; append-only.

resources.name: Project registry
resources.description: Project registry with status and coverage
